items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: And so Ivan and I made a bet, I said, I tell you what I bet you.

ctx.x: Right, right. But prior to that, I was sweet on her sister. I saw her sister who was already married and had three children, but I didn't know it at the time. So Ivan told me, he said, look, man, I can do you any good. Say, look, that sister-in-law, she's probably got three children already and another one might be on the way. He said, but the other sister, the other one you were checking out, she's single. That's the baby girl. I said, she seemed to not like me. I said, but I tell you what, I'm going to see if I…
